source: due2-native: an action that no vocabulary, profile, or the policy defines
notes: IM 2.1 requires a policy to use only ODRL terms or to declare the profiles whose terms it uses. ex:promote is neither, so the policy is not valid ODRL 2.2: tools/check_odrl22.py reports the undefined term and also the action class check of IM 2.5.4, since nothing types ex:promote as an odrl:Action. Until decisions/0020 both checkers passed such a policy, as they passed the 347 DALICC licenses with their undeclared dalicc: actions (docs/design/references.md, DALICC). A policy that types ex:promote as an odrl:Action in its own graph is admitted, as the rl2-* cases do.

expected_rejection.why: The action ex:promote is not an odrl: term, the policy declares no profile that defines it, and the policy does not type it (decisions/0020 #1, #2). W1 rejects the policy in stage 1.
